name: Cyclone Valkyrie
description: A Valkyrie reborn in cyclone fury. Cyclone Valkyrie spins so fast it generates a localized storm — the faster it moves, the more devastating its strikes become, turning speed itself into a weapon.

ability.name: Cyclone Rush
ability.description: Each Attack win builds Cyclone stacks (+10 ATK, max 5). At 3 stacks, gains Cyclone Mode for 2 turns — all attacks hit twice and the first hit ignores defense. At 5 stacks, releases a Cyclone Burst: 55 true damage and stacks reset.

chain._note: Cyclone Burst: 55 true damage at 5 stacks

special_move.name: Cyclone Storm Strike
special_move.description: Valkyrie becomes a living cyclone — four lightning-fast strikes that devastate everything in the storm's path!
flavour_texts: 💥 **Strike 4** — CYCLONE STORM STRIKE — EYE OF THE HURRICANE!
